description: Clay is a GTM data-enrichment and workflow automation tool that lets users pull in 75+ data providers and build outbound workflows in a spreadsheet-like interface, with an HTTP API integration feature and an official MCP server.
access_notes: Clay's HTTP API is a feature inside the product (used to connect external tools into a Clay table) rather than a conventional public developer API for building third-party toolkits against Clay itself; which pricing tiers include it was not confirmed from official docs.
api_notes: The HTTP API integration is primarily inbound/outbound data-connection tooling for Clay's own tables, not a full object-model API for managing Clay itself; MCP is the more agent-relevant surface (see MCP fields).
main_blocker: Clay's core product surface is workflow/enrichment automation rather than a conventional REST object model; the official MCP is the more meaningful agent-integration path but its scope (running existing Clay workflows vs. general CRUD) differs from most other apps in this dataset and needs a human judgment call on fit.
